answers.sql: SELECT 100.0*((SELECT transfer_volume FROM exports WHERE period='P2')/(1.0*(SELECT transfer_volume FROM exports WHERE period='P1'))-1) AS value

WITH totals AS (SELECT period,SUM(amount_units) amount FROM events WHERE event_kind='transfer' GROUP BY period) SELECT 100.0*((SELECT amount FROM totals WHERE period='P2')/(1.0*(SELECT amount FROM totals WHERE period='P1'))-1) AS value
